verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Slack has per-method API reference pages (chat.postMessage) and publishes an OpenAPI spec. Nothing documents an interactive explorer or runnable or try-it examples in the reference. The OpenAPI spec is a developer building block someone could load into their own tooling, not the product's own interactive reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
